# logreg example
```{r}
data(carotenoids)

dcaro <- subset(carotenoids, !is.na(diabetes))

# fit logreg
fit1 <- icglm(diabetes ~ sex + bmi + ic(zl, zr, "caro"), family = binomial,
              data = dcaro, Lin = TRUE,
              Rin = with(dcaro, zl == zr))

summary(fit1)
```

# normal example
```{r}
fit_norm <- icglm(diabetes ~ sex + bmi + ic(zl, zr, "caro"), family = gaussian,
                  data = dcaro, Lin = TRUE, 
                  Rin = with(dcaro, zl == zr))
summary(fit_norm)
```

# my DGP
```{r}
data <- datagen()
vars <- c("Y", "X", "CL", "CR", "Z1", "Z2", "Z3", "Dobs", "DR", "DL")
datafit <- as.data.frame(data[vars])

nconstants <- nimble_constants(data, pz = 3)
ndata <- nimble_data_years(data, nconstants)
ninits <- nimble_inits(data, 3, nconstants, ndata)

midz <- numeric(100)
midz[nconstants$idx_cen] <- ninits[["x_cen"]]
midz[nconstants$idx_obs] <- ndata[["x_obs"]]


glm0 <- glm(
  Y ~ -1 + Z1 + Z2 + Z3 + midz,
  family = gaussian,
  data = datafit
)

start <- c(
  coef(glm0),
  summary(glm0)$dispersion
)

Lin <- datafit$Dobs == 1
Rin <- datafit$DR == 1

datafit$CR_finite = datafit$CR
datafit$CR_finite[is.infinite(datafit$CR) & datafit$CR > 0] <- max(datafit$CR[is.finite(datafit$CR)]) + 1000
```


```{r}

data_int_only <- datafit %>%
  filter(Dobs == 0 & DL == 0 & DR == 0)

fit_me <- icglm(Y ~ -1 + Z1 + Z2 + Z3 + ic(CL, CR, "X"), family = gaussian,
                data = data_int_only)

summary(fit_me)



```
